subject: Please hold payments - account closed
text:
Hello,

Please be advised that our account ending in 2222 has been closed. Any payments sent to it will be returned. Please place a hold on payments to Acme Fasteners until we provide our new banking details, which our controller will send early next week.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Acme Fasteners LLC
Accounts Receivable
label: change_request
note: Borderline: no new destination yet, only 'stop paying the on-file account, new details to follow'. Counted as a change request because the vendor is announcing that future payments will go somewhere new.
